newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen lower again with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen lower again with Wall Street.

text.p: French shares were seen opening lower on Thursday, extending Wednesday's two percent drop after fresh Wall Street losses rattled foreign investors, brokers said.
CAC-40 futures for April fell to 2,518 from Wednesday's 2,527 ahead of the formal opening, with traders targeting 2,505 if the 2,520 resistance level gives way on the main index.
One broker said this was likely to happen quickly with the index set to open between 2,515 and 2,520.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 51.54 points or 2.0 percent on Wednesday at 2,530.20.
